props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the element.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description:
Called when the form is submitted and the schema validates. Receives the schema output
(after any `valibot` transforms, not the raw input) and the native `SubmitEvent`. The native
submit is always prevented, and invalid submits focus the first invalid field without calling
this handler. `form.isSubmitting` stays `true` until a returned promise settles; a thrown
or rejected error is stored in the form `errors` instead of propagating.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: translations
props.description: Localized message overrides for this form instance. `unknownError` is the form error recorded when a submit handler throws an error without a `message`.

props.name: as
props.description: The HTML element or component to render as.

props.name: children
props.description: Content, or a render function that receives the field state as props.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: description
props.description:
Description rendered under the label, above the control. It is linked to the control with
`aria-describedby`.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether nested controls inherit a disabled state. A control's own `disabled` prop takes
precedence.

props.name: error
props.description:
Error message rendered under the control; it replaces `help` and marks the control with
`aria-invalid`. When unset (`undefined` or `null`), the error of the form binding is used.
`false` suppresses any error, including the bound one. Empty content such as `''` or
`true` displays nothing.

props.name: help
props.description:
Help text rendered under the control. It is hidden while an error is displayed and linked to
the control with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: hiddenLabel
props.description:
Visually hidden label used as the accessible name when `label` has no content. Ignored when
`label` is non-empty.

props.name: hint
props.description:
Hint rendered beside the label, such as "Optional". Only shown when the field has a label
(visible or `hiddenLabel`).

props.name: id
props.description:
Prefix for the IDs of the label, hint, description, help, and error elements, which are
used for `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`. It is not set on the root element.
A unique ID is generated when omitted.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label for the control. Rendered as a `<label>` pointing to the nested control and used as
its `aria-labelledby`. Empty content (`''`, `null`, `false`) counts as no label.

props.name: name
props.description:
Schema field this `Field` binds to. A string is a top-level key of the schema, and an
array is a path to a nested object property or array item, such as `['profile', 'name']`
or `['tags', 0]`. A dotted string like `'profile.name'` is read as one top-level key.
examples:
import { createForm, Field, Input } from 'moraine'
import * as v from 'valibot'

const form = createForm({ schema: v.object({ profile: v.object({ name: v.string() }) }) })

<form.Form>
  <form.Field name={['profile', 'name']} label="Name"><Input /></form.Field>
</form.Form>

props.name: orientation
props.description: Visual layout direction.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether nested controls inherit a read-only state. A control's own `readOnly` prop takes
precedence.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether nested controls inherit the required state (`aria-required`) and the label shows a
required indicator. A control's own `required` prop takes precedence.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.
